pictures.name: ET1-Bodhi-Tree
pictures.prompt: Ancient India, night, beneath a huge spreading fig tree with heart-shaped leaves beside a quiet river. Siddhartha, a man of about thirty-five with short dark curled hair in the traditional style, in a simple saffron-ochre robe over one shoulder, seated cross-legged on a mat of grass, hands resting in his lap, eyes lowered, perfectly calm. Moonlight through the leaves, a soft gold glow around him, deep blue night. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: ET2-Mara-Comes
pictures.prompt: Ancient India, night, a wild storm of dark wind and swirling clouds around a huge fig tree. Beneath it, small and still in the center, Siddhartha, a man of about thirty-five with short dark curled hair in the traditional style, in a simple saffron-ochre robe over one shoulder, seated cross-legged on a mat of grass, unmoved. Above and behind him loom shadowy, fearsome demon shapes, and Mara, a tall proud figure in dark jeweled robes and a tall crown, riding a great grey elephant. No weapons striking, no one hurt; the storm bends around the calm seated man. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
